hook.name: OrkidKineticHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fee adjustments in beforeSwap based on route scores from an external PhysicsValidator contract (aligned flow → 0%, misaligned → 10%). In afterSwap, whitelisted bots can trigger JIT arbitrage via poolManager flash accounting (vacuum execution); non-whitelisted callers receive only fee gating.
